title: Routing help guides and selector-state stability hardening
acceptance_criteria: A reusable help dialog component exists for page-level operator guidance.
Routing protocol how-to guides are available from OSPF, IS-IS, OpenFabric, RIP, MPLS, BFD, RPKI, IGMP Proxy, PIM, and PIM6 pages.
Routing selector shells avoid setState-in-effect patterns and derive selected panel deterministically.
Frontend typecheck/build and runtime/browser smoke pass after changes.
assumptions: Guide content can focus on operational setup and verification while linking to upstream VyOS docs for complete option references.
Selector pages will remain inline panel switchers in this slice (no route refactor).
Unrelated dirty files in this worktree remain untouched.

tasks.notes: Added reusable help dialog and integrated page-level guides across core unicast, infrastructure, and multicast protocol pages.
Removed effect-driven selection resets and switched to derived-selection state for stability and reduced flicker.
Validated with tsc, lint, build, runtime smoke, and browser smoke.
Manual review: no contract changes, no free-form CLI UX regressions, and no route-level runtime crashes observed in smoke.
